plugins.name: Space Trader
plugins.description: The Palm OS classic, played in the chat window, from a panel with the ship's bars, a star chart you press to jump, and a market dealt as a hand of cards — one commodity each, with what it costs here, where in range pays more and what the difference comes to a cargo bay. Trade between 140 star systems, fight off the pirates who stop you on the way a round at a time, and buy off the haulers who only wanted to sell you something. You make every move; the model reads the position each turn and advises, and never spends your credits or fires your guns itself.
plugins.author: alexbeatnik
